items.title: The companies emerging as new leaders in this renewed AI rally
items.summary: Yahoo Finance Markets and Data Editor Jared Blikre examines the comeback seen across the semiconductor landscape over the past five trading days, while also analyzing which companies are emerging as leaders in the renewed AI rally.

items.title: Marvell Is Positioned to Absorb a Disproportionate Amount of This AI Capex Surge, So I Keep Buying
items.summary: Hyperscalers are quietly ripping out the networking fabric of every major data center, and one overlooked chipmaker keeps landing the contracts that make that rebuild possible. Here is why every pullback in the stock has become another buying opportunity.

items.title: Who Will Benefit Most From Amazon and Microsoft’s Hyperscaler Leading AI Capex This Quarter?
items.summary: Amazon and Microsoft are burning through roughly $100 billion a quarter on AI infrastructure, and two companies sit directly in that cash flow's path. One just tripled its free cash flow and rallied hard. The other beat on every line and still dropped 12 percent.

items.title: Marvell Stock Amplifies The Market You Already Own
items.summary: Its five-year correlation to the index says overlap, and its past-year capture readings say that overlap arrives magnified in both directions.

items.title: Can MRVL's Communications Recovery Drive Broad-Based Growth?
items.summary: Marvell Technology's communications business is rebounding as AI networking demand accelerates, but can that momentum offset margin pressure and uneven recovery trends?

items.title: The Ultimate Bull Case for NVIDIA Is Here: Their Powerful B200 Systems Are Sold Out
items.summary: NVIDIA just delivered its loudest quarter of the AI era, yet shares sit nearly 30% below their peak while B200 systems vanish from shelves faster than they ship. The bull case for a run to $300 hinges on three things that still need to break right.

items.title: Marvell Unveils AI Memory Strategy to Boost Server Efficiency. What That Means for MRVL Stock.
items.summary: Marvell unveils new AI memory chips and optical tech to address server bottlenecks, as its data center business continues to grow rapidly.

items.title: Amazon’s AWS CEO Just Sent Shivers Down the Spines of AI Bears. Supply is Mostly ‘Spoken For’ Through 2028.
items.summary: AWS chief Matt Garman just posted something on X that stopped AI skeptics cold, and the suppliers quietly sitting on his order books are already feeling it in their stock prices.
